answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Sanctified motor mechanic licence with motor traders attestation. It demands a licence traders renew after workshop audits, and the falcon is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the onyx compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the atlas is that the farm's unit economics never work.
